Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation & renewal: evidence handoff + capacity uplift

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the productive renewal call last week. Per our conversation, FinWave's renewal window is coming up (contract ends 2027-06-30) and you indicated interest in both the SOC 2 re-attestation and a modest throughput uplift to cover peak batch loads for Q4. I wanted to start an evidence handoff thread and outline a simple mutual-action plan so we can lock timelines and avoid last-minute scramble.

High level asks from our side:
- Confirm the evidence staging window you prefer (we can support a 2-week bulk transfer or a rolling 6-week ingest).
- Confirm retention horizon you require for audit logs (standard is 18 months; you mentioned possibly 24).
- Let us know target effective date for the capacity increase (do you want the bump at renewal or earlier for the pilot?).

I attached an evidence-index.csv and a retention-matrix.pdf showing the artifacts we typically provide for re-attestation and the fields we need filled out on your side.

Proposed next steps (quick):
1) You confirm staging window and retention by Tue 16 Mar.
2) We open a shared Drive folder and drop the first tranche of artifacts. (link below)
3) Legal sends a short term amendment for the capacity uplift and retention change; if that looks good sign via DocuSign and we proceed.

Shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-finwave-evidence
Draft term amendment (placeholder): https://docusign.com/packet/FW-2027-0451-term-amend

Happy to jump on a short call with your compliance team if helpful — we can tailor the artifact window to minimize operational overhead for FinWave.

Best,
Marissa
Head of Renewals | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199

Marissa,

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers and a couple of asks from our side:
- Staging window: rolling 4-week ingest preferred (smaller batches reduce lift).
- Retention: we do need 24 months for our regulators; any cost delta we should expect for that?
- Capacity bump: we want the uplift effective 2027-07-01 (at renewal), but would like a 30-day pilot in June if possible.

A few requests for the evidence set before we confirm:
1) Can you provide a small sample of system logs (redacted) so our SI can validate formats?
2) We need a completed SOC 2 questionnaire (we'll attach our template) and a list of the control owners.
3) Please route the term amendment draft to procurement@finwave.com and our legal counsel (I cc'd procurement here).

Happy to set a 30-minute sync with our compliance lead this week. When can Kimberly (your security lead) be available?

Best,
Jordan Lowe
Director, IT Compliance | FinWave Bank
